name: Liminal
source:
Liminal is a short, hand-painted, and partially-voiced visual novel about two young adults who accidentally run into each other a few months after their breakup.

[From [url=https://roman-hyacinths.itch.io/liminal]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Liminal》是一部採用手繪畫面、帶有部分配音的短篇視覺小說。兩個年輕人分手幾個月後，偶然間又遇見了彼此。

［取自[url=https://roman-hyacinths.itch.io/liminal]Itch.io[/url]］
